target: Only the axillary leaf clusters (short axillary shoots bearing leaves) are absent; record leaf PO:0025034 absent PATO:0000462 with the context 'in leaf axils', or hold it back. target: Nothing is absent for the taxon. The basal leaf sheaths PO:0020104 have no blade; the leaf lamina PO:0020039 of the normal leaves is present and flat. If kept, record it as leaf sheath with context 'basal, bladeless', or hold it back.

target: The stem PO:0009047 (scape or flowering stem) is leafless. The basal leaves PO:0025034 are present, with a cuneate base. Do not record leaf PO:0025034 absent PATO:0000462.

target: Leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 absent PATO:0000462. Oral setae (trichome PO:0000282 at the sheath mouth) absent. 'Leathery' describes the culm sheath: leaf sheath PO:0020104 coriaceous. Neither record belongs on stipule PO:0020041.

target: Nothing is absent. The flowers are unknown (missing data). The pseudoracemose arrangement probably describes the infructescence PO:0006342 if only fruiting material is known.
fix: 'Flowers not known', 'flowers unknown', 'not seen' and 'not yet collected' mean missing data. They never become absent PATO:0000462.

target: Only the leafy bracts (the bract star around the head cluster, bract PO:0009055 with context 'subtending the capitulum cluster') are absent. The brownish bracts are the phyllaries: involucral bract PO:0009045, brown. Do not record bract absent for the taxon.

target: Leaf lamina vein PO:0020138 (marginal vein) absent PATO:0000462. The leaf lamina PO:0020039 is present, with a cuneate base.

target: Nothing is absent. The flowers were not seen (missing data). 'Hispid' probably describes the infructescence PO:0006342 or its axis.

target: Only the absence is correct: leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 absent PATO:0000462, and oral setae (trichome PO:0000282) absent. Drop the record 'leaf sheath auricle present'.

target: Leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 absent PATO:0000462 (probably on the culm sheath; leaf sheaths may still have auricles, so keep the sheath type as context). 'White powdery' describes the culm sheath or internode: leaf sheath PO:0020104 or stem PO:0009047, not stipule.
fix: In bamboo descriptions, 'auricles absent' maps to leaf sheath auricle PO:0020106 and keeps the sheath type ('culm sheath' or 'leaf sheath') as context. Powdery or waxy words go to the sheath or internode named in the sentence. Never use stipule PO:0020041 as a bearer.
reason: Bamboos have no stipules. The epithet 'auriculatum' suggests some sheaths have auricles, so the absence is restricted to one kind of sheath.

target: Involucral bract PO:0009045 (the bracts of the umbel involucre) absent PATO:0000462. 'Almost equal' belongs to the bracteoles PO:0009043 (involucel) or the umbel rays, not to bract.
fix: In Apiaceae, 'bracts' means the involucre bracts at the base of the compound umbel (involucral bract PO:0009045) and 'bracteoles' means the involucel. Never record bract PO:0009055 absent, because PO's bract includes bracteoles.
reason: Seseli often lacks involucre bracts but has bracteoles. Recording plain 'bract' absent clashes with the bracteoles.

target: Only the outer calyculus bracts or peduncle bracteoles (bracteole PO:0009043, context 'calyculus/peduncle') are absent. The phyllaries, involucral bract PO:0009045, are present and sparsely fulvous villous.

target: The stem PO:0009047 is leafless except at the apex. The leaves PO:0025034 are present (bractlike at the stem apex, and basal or lower leaves elsewhere). Do not record leaf PO:0025034 absent PATO:0000462.

target: The stem PO:0009047 is almost leafless. The basal leaves PO:0025034 are present (undivided or lyrately pinnatifid). Do not record leaf PO:0025034 absent PATO:0000462.
fix: 'Almost leafless', 'nearly leafless' and 'subaphyllous' are not absences. Hedged absences ('almost', 'nearly', 'sub-') must never produce absent PATO:0000462. Bare 'leafless' in a stem sentence applies to that axis only.
reason: Youngia has a basal rosette of leaves. 'Almost leafless' describes the stems.

target: The style PO:0009074 is absent in the sterile ray florets and exserted in the disc florets PO:0009046. Keep 'ray floret' or 'disc floret' as context on each record.

target: Only the lateral (external) bracts on the fig receptacle wall are absent: bract PO:0009055 absent PATO:0000462 with context 'lateral, on syconium wall'. The basal bracts PO:0009055 are present and cupulate PATO:0002342.

target: Only the lateral bracts on the fig wall are absent: bract PO:0009055 absent PATO:0000462 with context 'lateral'. The basal bracts PO:0009055 are present and whorled PATO:0001951.

target: Idioblast PO:0000283 (cystoliths) absent PATO:0000462 in the leaf lamina. The leaf lamina PO:0020039 is present and subcoriaceous.

target: The leaf lamina PO:0020039 is not punctate (negation of punctate PATO:0001512): it has no dots. The leaf PO:0025034 is present, with a cuneate base. Hold the record back if negated qualities are not supported.

target: The leaf lamina PO:0020039 is not punctate (negation of punctate PATO:0001512). The leaf lamina is present, and its upper surface is brown when dry.

target: The awn PO:0025349 (lemma awn PO:0006032) is present on the upper lemma. 'Awnless' describes another member: the lower floret, the glumes, or the pedicelled spikelet. Keep the floret or spikelet as context on each record.

target: The stem PO:0009047 is absent (the plant is acaulescent) and that record is correct. 'Rhachis stout, angled, geniculate' belongs to inflorescence axis PO:0020122, which is bent.

target: The palea PO:0009038 is absent or vestigial in the lower (sterile) floret. The upper (fertile) floret palea PO:0009038 is present and indurate. Keep 'lower floret' or 'upper floret' as context; ideally map the record to palea, not to inflorescence bract PO:0009054.

target: Both records are about hairs, not the leaf. Leaf trichome PO:0006504 is absent on one surface (the one named in the structured character, probably adaxial) and present on the abaxial surface. The leaf PO:0025034 is present.
